title: Thin-film campaign loop 2, negative: Zwicker-style feeding (liquid made only in the precursor film, decayed inside drops) arrests coarsening into a lattice of 15-18 drops of one size, and keeps 6-13 extensile worms from coarsening, but no drop or worm divides persistently
summary: world.py adds to loop 1's fed thin film a source ks V exp(-((h-ha)/0.3)^2) that makes liquid only where the film is at precursor thickness, so it reaches drops by lubrication flow through the thin film and decays inside them at kd (Zwicker et al. 2017 on a substrate); the chemical-potential exchange is off (Qev 0). Passive (screens2.png rows 1-3, 96-128^2, t=6000-8000): a noisy film dewets into a lattice of 15-21 drops of one size that stops coarsening; lower kd gives larger drops (median 290 -> 650 px) but none elongates or divides. Extensile stress (ca 0.3, chpa 0.2; rows 4-5) gives 6-13 writhing worms that pinch and fuse without coarsening to one body, unlike c24's unfed worms. Labkit on the motile worm setting (pack_m2, seeds 0-1, 128^2, t=8000): 72 and 67 splits against 76 and 61 merges, 0 persistent splits, max 6.2 body lengths.

finding.operator: precursor-film source plus internal decay (Zwicker active emulsion) on a lubrication thin film with polar activity
finding.control: loop 1 exchange-off arm (coarsens) and c24's unfed worms (coarsen to 1-3 bodies)
finding.result: 0 persistent splits in 2 labkit seeds (merge/split 0.91-1.06); 0 of 5 screened settings divide; feeding holds body number at 15-21 drops or 6-13 worms

limits: Single-seed screens with my own driver; labkit's robust threshold segments much of the thick film in the worm setting (occupancy 0.46-0.50), so its body counts there are coarse. In a partially wetting thin film the contact angle is fixed, so drop volume grows as R^3 while precursor influx grows as R: size selection is stable and gives no shape instability, which is my reading of why Zwicker division does not appear. The question now has 4 attempts (c24, c57 x2, with 2 reviews of c24): I suggest lowering its priority unless someone has a different route to division (a substrate with wettability that the drops change, or drops that make their own surfactant).
